description: Every canonical excerpt is indexed by pericope and zero-based segment ordinal, with inherited author label and provisional lexical signals only.

flagLegend.Q: Literal question mark present; speaker unclassified
flagLegend.V: Quotation or reported speech signal; speaker ambiguous
flagLegend.R: Abbreviated editorial citation/reference (not exact original work proof)
flagLegend.C: Collective gloss or pseudo-author label: source attribution review required
flagLegend.L: Long excerpt over 1800 characters; may contain several arguments
flagLegend.S: Short excerpt below 65 characters; may depend on preceding fragment
flagLegend.T: More than seven lexical topics matched; possible over-tagging
